channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Humboldt Park Getting Upgrades — But No Pickleball Courts After All
item.description: The Park District scrapped its plan to add the courts after surveying residents. Planned improvements include rehabbed tennis courts and a new grass football field.

item.title: Gale Street Inn Reopens Thursday, Bringing Back Its Famous Ribs
item.description: The beloved Jefferson Park restaurant abruptly closed at the end of June. New owner Paulo Villabona said reservations are booked through the weekend.

item.title: Chicago Could Ban Hemp Products As Push Advances To Final Vote
item.description: Ald. Marty Quinn’s proposed citywide ban could deal the knockout blow to hemp businesses already facing a federal ban expected to take effect late next year.

item.title: Quantum Developers’ Environmental Cleanup Plans For Old South Works Steel Site Approved By State
item.description: Plans to remediate pollution at the lakefront megadevelopment gained conditional approval from the Illinois Environmental Protection Agency this week.

item.title: Ravenswood’s Lillstreet Art Center Celebrates 50 Years As A Home For Artists
item.description: To mark the milestone, the studio is throwing a holiday party Friday night and will host Saturday jewelry trunk shows throughout December.

item.title: How The Feds Used Propaganda To Frame Their ‘War’ On Chicago: ‘They’re Lying Constantly’
item.description: Homeland Security has sought to reshape violent encounters into triumphant narratives — even as judges, journalists and experts said the agency has repeatedly distorted facts, misled the public and attacked those who challenged its story.

item.title: Prosecutors Drop Charge Against Laugh Factory Manager Arrested During Lakeview Immigration Sweep
item.description: Nathan Griffin was accused of assaulting a federal officer, a claim disputed by witnesses and his family. The dismissal comes amid a series of similar outcomes in other cases brought during the immigration enforcement surge.

item.title: Chicago Promoted 2 Police Officers After Investigators Found They Engaged in Sexual Misconduct
item.description: The Chicago Police Department’s promotions system allows officers’ disciplinary records to be ignored. Despite years of reform efforts, nothing has changed.

item.title: 18 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Hyde Park Holly-Day, Tree Lightings And Holiday Markets
item.description: Hyde Park Holly-Day, the One of a Kind Art Show and Ravenswood Light Up Nights Festival are all on deck.

item.title: New Near West Side Memorial Coincides With Anniversary Of Black Panther Leader’s Killing
item.description: The Near West Side apartment where Black Panthers Fred Hampton and Mark Clark were assassinated by Chicago Police is the latest site to be commemorated on the Black Panther Party Heritage Trail.
